validator_limitations: Layout rules inspect all .layout string literals and do not model filesystem namespaces, actual call sites, or control-flow guards.
Layout rules skip silently when no $PBOPREFIX$ is found at the scan root.
Vanilla errors compare as unique rule/file pairs; warning comparison is count-by-rule, not identity or location.
A static PASS is not compilation, packaging, signing, load-order, or runtime evidence.
Exact GetType warnings cannot determine whether exact matching is intentional.
